crossRefs.note: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
For the body is not one member, but many.

translations.web: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
translations.bsb: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
translations.kjv: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
translations.asv: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
